question: ______ is India's first indigenously built warship.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​INS Godavari.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **INS Godavari**

 
 
• ​​INS Godavari (F20) was the lead ship of its class of guided-missile frigates of the Indian Navy.
 
• It was Built by** Mazagon Dock Limited** in Mumbai.
 
• It was the first Indian warship to be indigenously designed and built.
 
• It was commissioned on **10 December 1983.**
 
• It was decommissioned on** 23 December 2015** after a **32-year** career.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **INS Shivalik**

 
 
• INS Shivalik (F47) is the lead ship of its class of stealth multi-role frigates built for the Indian Navy.
 
• It is the** first stealth warship **built by India.
 
• It was built at the** Mazagon Dock Limited (MDL) **located in Mumbai.
 
• It underwent sea trials from thereon before being commissioned on 29 April 2010.
 
 
 
• **INS Arihant**
 
 
• INS Arihant is a designated **S2 Strategic Strike Nuclear Submarine.**
 
• It is the lead ship of India's Arihant class of nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarines. 
 
• The **6,000-tonne** vessel was built under the Advanced Technology Vessel (ATV) project at the Ship Building Centre.
 
• Arihant was launched on **26 July 2009,**
 
 
 
• **INS Talwar**
 
 
• INS Talwar (F40) is the lead ship of the **Talwar-class frigates** of the Indian Navy.
 
• Its name means "Sword" in Hindi.
 
• It was built in Russia, and commissioned into the Indian Navy on **18 June 2003.**
